subject: The confession I wasn't going to send about your 30 days
preview_text: I tracked what happens to people who use this app for a month vs those who don't. The difference is terrifying.
body_paragraphs: I looked at the data from the last 600 people who went through a breakup. It shows two very different paths. One group used the app. The other didn't. The results aren't just different. They're life-changing.

Without the app, the average person at Day 30 is still stuck in the same 3AM spiral. They're still checking their ex's social media. They still feel that identity loss, like a part of them is missing. They're just... surviving. With the app? By Day 30, people have tangible proof they're healing. Their mood chart isn't a flatline of sadness. They've built a no-contact streak that feels like armor. They have new coping strategies wired into their brain. They're not just surviving. They're rebuilding.

That proof comes from one feature: your personal Mood Tracker. It's the visual diary of your healing. Every single check-in builds the map that shows you're moving forward, even on the days it doesn't feel like it. It turns abstract pain into a clear, upward line.

Open the app right now and tap your Mood Tracker. Just log today's mood. In 30 days, you'll look back at that chart and see your own strength. It's the most powerful thing you can do for yourself today. P.S. The users who check their mood just 10 times in 30 days report feeling 60% more in control. That starts with one tap.
cta_text: Log Today's Mood in the App
